sources: dossier=Required behaviors ('Held state and held-cascade rule... During the hold, cascade flows only among held-subgraph members... fires its own deferred cascade to non-members only', 2026-06-20..21 transcript) and Corrections record ('the sketch's blanket defer all cascade from held until commit/abandon was corrected by the user — cascade among holders within the claim scope continues during the hold', 2026-06-20 transcript); doc=cascade.md:40 said walker does NOT fire at the held terminal; code=runner_terminal.go held branch emits terminal/success + attribute-change filtered to subgraphMemberFilter at the held terminal, held_cascade_defer.go defers only non-members
note: Doc invariant directly contradicted both the code and its own cited decision (held-as-state-not-phase). Rewrote to state co-member cascade fires immediately at the held terminal and only non-members are deferred.

sources: dossier=Required behaviors ('Cascade modes govern the node_run queue only... one mode per node', 2026-07-03 transcript; 'Gate-fix set ratified 2026-07-05... the cascade-mode drop check runs before the same-node serialization check'); doc=Boundaries (line 28) omitted concept:cascade-mode from Owns/Adjacent, pitfall (line 47) described only pending->stale; code=gate_evaluator.go GetCascadeMode->applyCascadeModeRule->DropPendingRun is a real third outcome at gate-clear
note: cascade-mode is a real adjacent concept governing a gate-clear outcome (drop) the doc never named. Added concept:cascade-mode to Boundaries Does-NOT-own/Adjacent and noted the drop outcome in the executor-invocation pitfall.

sources: dossier=Required behaviors ('force_upstream_refresh structural guarantee... force-upstream dispatch happens structurally before the dispatching node', 2026-06-15 transcript) and ('Enqueue-time upstream-run pinning... pinned at enqueue via the wait-set row's sender_run_id', 2026-07-13 transcript); doc=cascade.md:34 invariant stated an unqualified 'iff' gated on signal-type+filter match, contradicting the doc's own line 30 ('Both feed the wait-set with the same row shape'); code=pullForceRefreshUpstreams inserts WaitSetRow gated only on upstream-refresh edges, no signal-type/filter match
note: The doc contradicted itself: Boundaries already describes two wait-set-feeding edge maps, but the invariant's 'iff' only covered one. Rewrote the invariant to state both insertion paths explicitly.

sources: dossier=Required behaviors ('Walker accumulation rule (a)... Natural-cascade wait-set inserts dedupe by sender_run_id; the walker reads all wait-set rows, not only drained ones', 2026-06-20..21 transcript); doc=cascade.md:39 accumulation rule stated only a per-sender-node check with no sender-run-level dedupe; code=ensureCascadePending in cascade_walker.go short-circuits to the latest pending via HasRowForSenderRun before the sender-node check
note: Dossier explicitly confirms a sender_run_id dedupe layer beneath the per-sender-node rule (required behavior, transcript-tier). Doc updated to state the same-run short-circuit before the sender-node check.

sources: dossier=Required behaviors ('Held state and held-cascade rule... cascade flows only among held-subgraph members', 2026-06-20..21 transcript) corroborated by decision held-as-state-not-phase (co-members must not gate each other's dispatch); doc=cascade.md:47 pitfall described the gate as firing purely on 'no subscribed upstream has an in-flight run', omitting the held co-member exemption; code=gate_evaluator.go anySubscribedUpstreamInFlight skips a held sender when it is a subgraph co-member
note: The held co-member gate exemption is real, dossier-corroborated behavior the pitfall omitted. Added the exemption to the executor-invocation pitfall in the same edit that addressed row 195's cascade-mode gap.

sources: dossier=Corrections/historical record ('(artifact-only) Pure-cascade (no-executor) runs are excluded from supervisor dispatch eligibility and advance through the scheduler's pure-cascade path', 2026-05-15 artifact; 'the empty-executor message-receiver path builds on it, 2026-06-22 transcript'); doc=cascade.md:18 fallthrough row named only the recorded reason (pure_cascade) as if it were the trigger, never stating the no-executor eligibility criterion; code=ListPureCascadeReady selects on (n.executor IS NULL OR n.executor = '')
note: Circular phrasing (pure_cascade cited as both trigger and outcome) with the actual per-node eligibility criterion (no executor) never stated. Rewrote to name the criterion and demote pure_cascade to 'the recorded transition-reason'.

sources: dossier=no entry defines 'color' vocabulary anywhere in the corpus; doc=cascade.md:37/48 used 'Settled-color' and 'the sender's color' without ever defining the term, and no concept file defines it catalog-wide (also used undefined in error-policy.md and parked-state.md)
